title: _event
description: Outbox record written by a write script in the same lock as the data write. Stored at .superteam/data/_event/{id}.json (gitignored). The engine processes events in id order and removes each one when done. Draft v0.

id.description: Order in the queue (the _event folder), allocated under the write lock. Not a unique identity: it only orders the events in the folder, and can start over once the queue is drained.

operation.description: create, update or delete a record. `ack` is only for workflow events: the workflow ran and has nothing to change; its target is the target of the published event and it has no changes.

changes.description: Changed fields only: field name -> { old, new }. On create every old is null; on delete every new is null.

causedBy.description: What caused this event, filled by whoever creates it. An integer is the id of the _workflow the endpoint ran, set on the workflow events it returns (checked by the engine). A string is the name of the skill that called a write script. Null for a manual call of a write script.

depth.description: 0 when written outside the engine, +1 for each engine-caused write. The engine refuses to go past its depth limit.
